notes.title: Emergency Update - Corrections Implemented
notes.content:
Emergency corrections have been made due to the issues found in the game. We apologize for the inconvenience and sincerely thank everyone for providing feedback and notifying us about these problems. The following modifications have been implemented to improve the gaming experience:

1- Temporary Removal of the Temporal Mage: The Temporal Mage has been temporarily removed until a final fix can be applied. This change will not affect the progress of the main game.

2- Fix for Karma Status Reduction: Now, upon defeating enemies, the character's Karma status is correctly reduced as expected.

3- Fix for Sacrifice System: The issue preventing sacrifice after completing Sofia’s mission has been resolved.

4- Potion and Quick Access Menu Adjustment: A delay issue that caused potions used from the inventory to not match the value shown in the quick access menu has been fixed.

5- Background Fix After the Wrath Sin Cutscene: The background issue that prevented progress after the Wrath Sin cutscene has been resolved.

6- Enemy Always Fleeing in Story Mode: The issue with enemies always fleeing in Story Mode will not be fixed, as this behavior is an intentional feature for that mode.

7- Secret Area Shortcut in Pride Sin: The shortcut to the secret area in the Pride Sin now correctly directs to the proper location.

Other Reported Issues: Other reported problems will be addressed and explained directly to those involved.

Once again, we appreciate the feedback and continue working to provide the best possible experience. If you have any further questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Fixed attack animations for certain skills to improve gameplay.

notes.title: Verfall Update - We Appreciate Your Feedback!
notes.content:
At the request of our users, we've made several important changes to improve the gameplay experience in Verfall:

[b]Passive Interactive Skills:[/b] It is no longer necessary to choose a leader to activate the skills. Now, as long as there is a member in the group with the skill, it will be enabled, making the process simpler and more dynamic.
[b]
NPC Positioning Fix: [/b]The NPC in the throne room at the beginning of the game has been repositioned for a better experience.

[b]Group Selection Map Optimization: [/b]The interface has been improved to group characters with the same abilities together. We've also added ability symbols next to each character to make identification easier.

[b]Intro Text Change:[/b] The initial text choice between "Start the Game" and "View the Story of Verfall" has been updated. We apologize for not including this option in the initial release.

[b]Difficulty Balancing: [/b]In response to player feedback, we've improved the balancing for the Easy and Normal difficulty levels, making them more accessible and enjoyable.

[b]Currency Conversion Fix: [/b]Upon further review, we noticed that the automatic price calculation resulted in discrepancies between the original price and the converted value in certain currencies. As a result, we manually adjusted the price to bring it closer to the ideal value. This change means that in some countries, the price will be lowered to better align with local currency values, while others will remain unaffected.

We apologize for any confusion or inconvenience caused by this change. We are actively studying ways to compensate players who were affected by the previous pricing. In the meantime, please note that on the Communities tab of the game's Steam page, you can find guides, as well as a direct contact option for reporting bugs, providing feedback, and asking questions.

These changes have been made with the goal of enhancing gameplay, based on feedback from our players. We thank everyone who contributed to improving the game experience!

notes.title: New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
New Features and Improvements

Hello, players!

We’re excited to bring a new update to Verfall! This version includes important improvements, bug fixes, and new features to enhance your gameplay experience. These changes are all based on valuable feedback from our community—thank you for your support!

What's New:

Option to Skip the Tutorial: Now you can choose between playing the tutorial and exploring the story of Verfall, or skipping directly into the game, saving time and jumping straight into the adventure!
Orb Bug Fixes: We’ve made adjustments to fix unintended interactions with the orbs at the start of the game, ensuring the story progression unfolds as intended.
Translation Updates: We’ve updated translations for several languages, including Russian, German, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Korean, to provide a smoother experience for our international players.
Gameplay Balancing Adjustments: We’ve made some changes to improve gameplay balance and offer a more engaging experience.
Future Updates: We are still working on further improvements, bug fixes, and new features. We appreciate your continued support and valuable feedback!

notes.title: Fix for the initial cutscene map
notes.content:
[b]Important Update[/b]

Hello, players!

We’re releasing a new update that includes an important fix to improve your experience:

[b]🔧 Fix for the initial cutscene map:[/b]

We noticed that on the map where the group is sent to investigate Adama’s Tomb after the heroes’ introduction, some interactions were unintentionally available. This could cause confusion or disrupt the intended flow of the game.
Now, access to NPCs and other elements on this map is limited, ensuring the cutscene proceeds smoothly and events unfold as planned.
[b]💡 Reminder:[/b]
This part of the game is still linear as it serves to introduce the heroes, mechanics, and storyline. Once you defeat the initial boss, the game truly begins—you’ll have more freedom to explore, choose stages, craft items, complete missions, and much more!

We deeply appreciate everyone who provided feedback, helping us make the game even better! Please keep sharing your experiences with us.

Enjoy your adventures, and as always, we’re here to help!

notes.title: Important Update - Improvements and New Features in Verfall 🌟
notes.content:
Dear players,
We’re excited to share a new update that brings adjustments, fixes, and new features to enhance your Verfall experience! Check out what’s new:

[b]Game Adjustments:[/b]
🔄 Repositioned one of the children to be rescued on Map 1 for better gameplay flow.
🎁 Added the coded chest to all difficulties (previously exclusive to Decadence difficulty).
⚔️ Reduced the number of enemies in the initial maps of the Tomb of Adama to ease early progression.
🛡️ Adjusted enemy attack areas on Map 2: enemies can no longer access the road, keeping the chase focused in the forest.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
👑 Corrected the Queen’s name in the throne room for consistency with the story.

[b]New Features:[/b]
🗺️ Complete guides: We’ve published 4 new guides in the Community Hub to assist you on your journey!
🌐 Official game page: Stay updated with all the latest news and information.
📹 YouTube channel: Watch introductory videos and dive deeper into Verfall’s world.


Thank you so much for your support and feedback! We’re continually working to improve your experience and always welcome your suggestions. Don’t forget to leave a review—it makes a huge difference!

If you have any questions or spot anything that needs our attention, let us know. We’re here to ensure you have the best time in the world of Verfall!

Enjoy the game! 🎮✨
